items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: I went on the road there one year with Frank Silverhead, the head of band one time. And we played in more bonds and tobacco bonds and things all around Georgia and South Carolina and Tennessee and Florida

ctx.x: One time I was following a colored parade in Marrero, you know, the jazz band. And they passed the dairy farm and the cows followed the band. They must have liked it. Must have influenced them some kind of way. And they would dance along, you know. That was funny. Fortunately, there's a movie of that. A friend of mine made a movie of that. You'd have to see the movie to believe it. I could imagine. That's pretty fantastic.

I went on the road there one year with Frank Silverhead, the head of band one time. And we played in more bonds and tobacco bonds and things all around Georgia and South Carolina and Tennessee and Florida, all the southern states, you know. We went as far as South Carolina. The band was sponsored by the Tesh Greyhound Company. And they finished the transportation and naturally we called it a band, the Tesh Greyhound Band, you know. And we played all around, all southern Louisiana, all Lafayette and Lake Charles,…
Were they mostly New Orleans guys?
